description:
This protocol performs a custom compound plating protocol as specified by a user-input .csv file. You can download an example .csv template here!
The same tip is used for each source, and the user is prompted to refill the deck state if all destination plates have been processed.

workflow.text: Replace 96-well plates and tip racks. Insert  two new tip racks in positions 10 and 11, remove all 96-well plates from positions 1-7, and insert five new 96-well plates in positions 1-5.

Liquid_1.labware: Opentrons 24 Tube Rack with Eppendorf 1.5 mL Safe-Lock Snapcap
